name: Braggers
overview: Scripture warns against boasting or performing righteous acts to gain human approval, emphasizing that such behavior forfeits the reward from the Father in heaven. Believers are instructed to give quietly and discreetly, so that even their own actions are humble and not self-promoting. Additionally, the community is called to mutual confession and prayer, highlighting that genuine righteousness is marked by humble dependence on God rather than self-exaltation.
